name: Book of the Dead Vita
description: The first Russian VN in history, released in May 2006.
long_description: The first Russian VN in history, released in May 2006. The plot follows a married couple who move into a gloomy mansion they inherited, where events unfold in the spirit of Lovecraft's works.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
